rules.session: the second-cohort session with the most place cells
rules.overlapping: the overlapping trio whose smallest pairwise map correlation is largest
rules.separate: the first separate trio in the stored sample whose three fields peak on one running direction
rules.ripples: ripples after the tracks whose most probable state is a stretch of about 40 cm or 1 m with posterior probability at least 0.8; the three with the most active place cells
